_: Evidence revisions. r1 is the blind-run freeze; every recorded row was produced by it. A later change to frozen inputs is a new revision: it declares what changed from r1 and how the recorded evidence was re-verified. The recorded rows are never re-generated or edited.

revisions.label: blind-run freeze
revisions.note: Every recorded row (blind-main, blind-repeat and the replay check) was produced by this code.

revisions.label: proposal-boundary fix
revisions.reason: An external review of the source found that the control-plane gateway also accepted an exact implementation name from the model and sent it through a path with no authoritative value binding. The model-facing gateway now accepts only capability tools surfaced to the model; an implementation name is stopped at the proposal stage.
revisions.exercised_note: No recorded control-plane proposal used the closed path: all 469 named a surfaced capability.

verification.method: deterministic replay of every recorded row through the r2 code, with the recorded model responses (no model)
verification.mismatch_cause: key order only: row files are written with sorted keys (sprawl_poc.util.write_json), so recorded tool-call arguments replay in sorted order, and the arguments the gateway echoes back in a tool result differ from the live run in key order; the values are identical
verification.control: the same mismatches appear, row for row, when the affected rows are replayed with the r1 code
